results.content:
## What Agenda Hero does

Agenda Hero markets itself as a platform that "converts anything to calendar events." Its core feature is Agenda Hero Magic: you type, paste, snap a photo, or upload a screenshot or PDF, and the AI parses it into a structured event with the title, date, time, location, description, and even an emoji filled in. You can edit any field afterward, and you refine results with a chat-style prompt. It handles multiple events from a single input (for example, pasting a soccer schedule or a newsletter) and supports recurring events including daily, weekly, every-other-week, monthly, and annual patterns. You can specify a start and end time ("11am to 1pm") or a start plus duration ("2pm for 90 minutes"). [...] ## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is Agenda Hero free?

Agenda Hero has a free tier ($0) that includes Agenda Hero Magic, Magic Pages, and Collaborative Calendars. Paid plans, as of June 2026, are Plus at $30 per user per year (billed annually) for unlimited AI edits and custom page URLs, and Organizations at $40 per year per account with a 10-seat minimum. Check agendahero.com/pricing for current details.

### What is the best Agenda Hero alternative?

If you want the same text-to-event parsing but faster and inside your browser, Text to Calendar is the closest alternative. It turns a highlight-and-right-click into a Google Calendar or Outlook event with no side panel or separate site, and it offers a dedicated Outlook extension that Agenda Hero handles as an export option. [...] If you're comparing Agenda Hero with Text to Calendar, the short answer is this: both use AI to turn messy text into calendar events, but they aim at different jobs. Agenda Hero is a full calendar product with a side panel, shareable "Magic Pages," and a directory of pre-built academic calendars; it exports to Google, Apple, and Outlook. Text to Calendar is a lightweight browser extension that lives where you already read text, turning a highlight into a Google Calendar or Outlook event with a right-click and no separate app to open. If you want a calendar destination and curated school schedules, Agenda Hero is the better fit. If you just want the fastest path from selected text to a saved event, Text to Calendar wins. SAN FRANCISCO, August 21, 2025--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Agenda Hero, the AI platform built to eliminate the world's manual calendar work, today launches Magic Chat, a conversational AI that turns messy notes, flyers, and PDFs into fully structured calendar events in seconds, and Magic Schedules, to share interactive, dynamic schedules that automatically sync with calendars. Backed by $5.6 million in venture capital led by Upfront Ventures, with participation from Precursor Ventures and pre-seed investor K9 Ventures, Agenda Hero is redefining how people create, share, and use schedules. - Magic Schedules — Shareable, brandable, beautiful schedule pages that automatically sync with calendars.
- Agenda Hero for Organizations — Custom colors, themes, and branding to keep every team, department, or chapter on the same page with the plan.
- Premium Plans starting at $30/year — Accessible pricing for individuals and organizations; Agenda Hero Magic remains free for all users. [...] Agenda Hero tackles one of the most universal yet overlooked productivity frustrations — the tedious process of getting schedules into calendars. Whether receiving a school calendar in a PDF, an offsite agenda in an email, or a printed soccer schedule, Agenda Hero transforms it into structured events for Google, Apple, or Outlook calendars. For those creating schedules, Agenda Hero replaces static PDF calendars with interactive, collaborative, calendar-synced schedules, eliminating manual work at the source for both creators and recipients.

results.content:
Unearth all sorts of awesome tech tools with my free Cool Tools newsletter from The Intelligence. A new time-saving treasure in your inbox every Wednesday!

## The scheduling supplement you didn’t know you needed

This tool is one of those things that’s almost shockingly simple but simultaneously so frickin’ smart, you’ll wonder how it isn’t already built into every calendar app out there.

➜ It’s a web-based system called Agenda Hero Magic, and it does one thing and one thing only: It makes it as easy as can be to add new events to your calendar in seconds flat—no formatting, no fuss, no hassle whatsoever. [...] Calendar apps are a dime a dozen these days—and no matter what platform or type of device you’re using, you’ve almost certainly got something that gets the job done.

But I’d be willing to wager there’s one area where your agenda juggling could do with an extra injection of intelligence. And that’s in the area of event creation.

Surely I’m not the only one who’s found myself sighing as I punch specific pieces of info from an email, a web page, or a random interaction into an event-adding interface, right? Powerful as they may otherwise be, most of our current calendar tools are frustratingly mediocre at making that easy.

But—oh, yes—there’s an easy answer. And it works brilliantly right alongside any other calendar app you’re using.
